name: MOSS-Image Online
tagline: Free AI image generator with real Chinese & English text in posters, menus and signs
description: Describe the picture and the exact words it should carry. MOSS-Image writes Chinese and English text into posters, menus and signs, and can place each element where you draw it with JSON layout boxes. Sign up free for 3 standard images (instant with Google). Online generator using the open-weight MOSS-Image model (OpenMOSS); nothing to install; full-size PNG download. Strongest wherever the words matter as much as the picture.
